countInfo.Council_Name: Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council

source.title: Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 4 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Newry No. 1 Rural District"); Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8 ("Newry No. 1 Rural District Council")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: Returning Officer's notice of result, column 6 (candidates elected) with no votes in column 5 (no poll), read on the page image (Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 4); sole nomination (Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8)

note: Triennial election of the 14 electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, 2 June 1949. There were no contests; no nomination was received for Clonduff and Mayo, whose retiring members were deemed to be re-elected. Returned unopposed.
